notes.title: BORNEO DEVLOG #10 - REBOOT
notes.content:
Hi everyone, [b]Fantastico Studio[/b] here.

The last few months have been very difficult due to personal problems related to [i][b]Maestro Ruggero Deodato[/b][/i], which have kept him away from the project for most of the time.

All this has, unfortunately, led to a big slowdown in the production of the game and on the roadmap we had initially planned and has forced us to re-plan a new one based on the slowdown we had in these months and, in the same way, to re-plan a new release date. 

By the way, we didn't stop. We are currently focused on the finalisation of a demo - still in Italian, but in the process of being localised - which will be shown in the next few months. We will look for a publisher to collaborate for better communication of the project.

In the new demo, we have been working on changing the fonts used in the project, as well as fixing and refining some UI elements such as:

[h3]Conversations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/c9b11b26d810618309f14b31153eff97dbe27dd9.gif[/img]

[h3]Dialogues[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/9363d4f385724d280f8ce5bb21e7521f2279c3f0.gif[/img]

[h3]Pause Menu[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/eaf32273de78ccb85c0109e97214d9673d5f817f.gif[/img]

[h3]Inventory[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/e19e133b7fb5c566c979ee944a21308a8ccae353.gif[/img]

[h3]QTE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/c39ad758a546c3a2b397f85a91d78af030ba3239.gif[/img]



[h1]Collectables and Notebook[/h1]

In the scenes of [b]Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare[/b] there are collectables that the player must find and collect. The items are used to determine the possibility of unlocking additional content at the end of the game and are represented in-game as snapshots taken by our characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/fed7e42189114b4b41200fc840d8b413089d138c.gif[/img]

The photos of the collectables will then be collected and displayed in one of the [b]Notebook [/b]sections. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/2b4747f6969c5eb87ad9adce37f9b8de3f5ee02a.jpg[/img]

The[b] Notebook[/b], presented in one of the last devlogs, is an indispensable tool for the player, and contains 3 different sections:
[list]
[*] [b]Scenes [/b]- in this section the player can document himself with a small summary of the scenes already played or decide to replay a specific scene
[*] [b]Characters [/b]- keeps track of the characters met during the game and provides information through a short bio
[*] [b]Collectables [/b]- gallery of collectables collected in the game by the player
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/741bafa635bb877630e9329a3b5e92d6268ca3d5.jpg[/img]



[h1]Acts and New Roadmap[/h1]

Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare is a game divided into 3 Acts that contain playable scenes. Currently, in Fantastico Studio we are finalizing Act I, which we expect to finish by next July.

[b]NEW ROADMAP[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]ACT I[/b] - July 2021
[*] [b]ACT II [/b]- December 2021
[*] [b]ACT III[/b] - March 2022
[*] [b]POLISHING & QA[/b] - April 2022
[*] [b]PUBLICATION[/b] - May 2022
[/list]

We end this [b]Devlog Reboot[/b] with a couple more information. 

The first one concerns our participation in the [b]Steam Game Fests[/b], for which we are deciding whether to attend the ones scheduled for next October or to go directly to the ones at the beginning of 2022.

The second news is that from now on, [b]Devlogs[/b] will be offered every [b]3 weeks[/b] to fully concentrate on development in the meantime.

Thank you all for your attention, and see you in the next devlog!

notes.title: BORNEO DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome back to our [b]DEVLOG[/b] series on [b]BORNEO: A Jungle Nightmare[/b].


Before we get into the third episode, we would like to introduce you to two initiatives we have prepared for you in the past few days.

The first one is a contest we're going to hold on [b]Twitter[/b], in which all users who want to participate will have the chance to win a wonderful print of the game, signed by [i][b]Monsieur Cannibale[/b][/i] himself, [b]Ruggero Deodato[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/7f06d1e5f30703199cc9816b6e96fb21b088b7c9.jpg[/img]

Each contest will offer only one print among the available ones and will have precise rules. The first contest will start on [b]Wednesday 23rd December[/b] on [url=https://twitter.com/fantasticodev][b]our official Twitter profile[/b][/url]: follow our account for all the information on how to participate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/2737c1908982e99d1417d3f842781ec9a7f3b3e5.gif[/img]

The second initiative is dedicated to the users of [url=https://discord.gg/NfAmM8Twxs][b]our official Discord server[/b][/url], which consists in an AMA: starting from today and until next [b]January 6th[/b], we will collect all the questions we receive in the specific channel (AMA-Deodato) on the server.
 
The best ones will be selected and sent to the director Ruggero Deodato, who will answer in a video message! If you are a fan of Ruggero Deodato's work, you can't miss this opportunity: join the server and go wild with your questions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/180046f0c5107b0d3f380e3f60e8e036c67b3399.png[/img]

After talking about the coming surprises, let's start introducing the characters present in [b]BORNEO: A Jungle Nightmare[/b].


[h3]PIERCE MEYER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/d4df7265d113149ef81b4016b108c8a2af7abcea.jpg[/img]

Pierce Meyer is the owner of the famous Bloody Disgusting, a website that has based its fortune and its core business on the publication of shocking movies and images - a bit like what happened with another famous shock site: Rotten.com

Pierce is a cynical and extremely determined person, so much so that he has no scruples when it comes to finding new, incredible material for his website. This always leads him to walk a tightrope, in a place where the boundaries between legality and illegality often blur and overlap. For these reasons he doesn't like dealing with the police very much and, when he can, he tends to avoid getting his hands dirty himself.


[h3]ALESSANDRO URBANI[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/189d0222e33538ca8527e06b83b03cce8da29271.jpg[/img]

Alessandro is a former reporter for a major international broadcast who now works as a freelancer. He often finds himself travelling the world in search of scoops and interesting news and even though he is the person who proposes to Pierce the sale of a VHS containing some scorching material, he has a good nature. 


[h3]JESSICA ASCHERMANN[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/1bbc9257d8848dad3218e71c4f51247598cc7b52.jpg[/img]

Jessica is a long-time collaborator of Pierce's and works actively at the website Bloody Disgusting. A journalist always on the lookout for sensational scoops, she often finds herself performing not-so-legal actions to retrieve material for Pierce. This annoys her quite a bit and she is frustrated by the fact that she has to perform these kinds of actions, but she can't help it because she suffers from Pierce's violent charm.


[previewyoutube=2iRTvQCMaqg;full][/previewyoutube]


If you have taken a look at our social media you will have already seen the short video above. 

It's a very rough example of what the aesthetics of [b]Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare[/b] will actually look like.

The game scenes will in fact be made up of some static elements and some animated ones, all composed in a scenic manner and handcrafted by the incredible [b]SoloMacello[/b].


Well, that's all for today! See you in next Devlog!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/b4017ef56c57633ff0891c9c3307ab3216209676.png[/img]

notes.title: BORNEO DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
After the release of the teaser with the official name of our game, we received a lot of messages from the natives of Borneo, who were afraid that our project would communicate a distorted reality of their beautiful country. So, after expressing our reasons and thoughts [url=https://blog.fantasticostudio.it/][b]in our blog[/b][/url], we decided to publish a version of the trailer with a disclaimer explaining a few things.


[previewyoutube=JbsaFhJRlAI;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]


As challenging as it was to process the massive number of messages we received, work on [b]BORNEO: A Jungle Nightmare[/b] continued as planned. 

As mentioned before, in [b]BORNEO: A Jungle Nightmare[/b] we will have to reconstruct the events that took place during the expedition in Borneo. 
To do so, we'll have to [b]relive the memories of the characters we interact with[/b]. 

[i][b]Conversing with them, in fact, will start the narration of their memories, which the players will live and play in first person.[/b][/i]

In the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1286420/view/2888459958417301061][b]last Devlog[/b][/url], we left off with a question about how to use the tools in [b]Pierce's studio[/b], such as the notebook, the computer or the characters. 
With today's devlog we see the first two elements, trying to understand in general terms and without spoiling too much of the plot of the game, what they are used for.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/70dc1b57933e9c3f879ff508b0d838423a194b97.jpg[/img]


[h3]THE NOTEBOOK[/h3]

The notebook is the element that allows keeping track of all the important events of the game's history.  Its pages summarise all the important information you have acquired during your adventure in the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/75832062251ed33b7012ca7baf06a59d4b30a6f8.jpg[/img]


This information relates to the memories we will play and will allow us to access them at a later time as well. Moreover, in the notebook are also present the [b]Collectibles[/b] that we will retrieve during the adventure.


[h3]THE PC[/h3]

By interacting with the computer, the desktop will be displayed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/dda5e083a489ef1b74fcf67b7d15350a21c89f4f.jpg[/img]


From here you can consult all the multimedia materials obtained before the conversation with the characters, such as video, photos or texts.
You can also access other icons on the desktop, such as the email client: during the story, we will receive emails that will allow us to play new scenes in which we will discover more details and information about the plot of [b]BORNEO: A Jungle Nightmare[/b].


[h3]MAKING OF A CHARACTER[/h3]

Last but not least, we leave you with a little goodie regarding the Making Of of one of the characters in the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37418071/a791943136c0eaf0d20b6431d4a655fbaa77ac00.gif[/img]


What do you think of this awesome work by [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/solomacello]SoloMacello[/url][/b]? 



Well, that's all for this week. See you at the next Devlog with more interesting news about the game!

notes.title: A little update from Fantastico Studio
notes.content:
Hello everyone, [b]Fantastico Studio[/b] here!

It's been a while since we last spoke about the [b]Deodato[/b] project dedicated to [b]Cannibals[/b]. 
The game due to [b]Covid[/b] has suffered a considerable delay but...

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/48ef42_2b58b51fdde04e189e44d1ae09a5d589~mv2.gif[/img]

... the project is absolutely not [b]dead[/b] -- sure, we can't say the same about the two characters in the teaser :D 


So, stay tuned, in the next few days there will be more [i][b]tasty[/b][/i] news about it!
